conservative.read: This mode focuses on capital preservation, aiming for lower monthly returns. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged positions and concentration. Expect a much lower drawdown potential but also capped upside.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to stay within mandate.

balanced.read: This balanced approach seeks risk-first growth, aiming for moderate monthly returns. It trims leverage and concentration while adding a defensive ETF. Expect controlled drawdowns and a blend of growth and stability.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and AI/Software/Chip names.

aggressive.read: This aggressive mode aims for stretched growth, targeting higher monthly returns. It concentrates exposure in leveraged ETFs and high-scoring tech names, accepting significantly higher drawdown risk. Daily leveraged ETF decay and strict stop discipline are critical.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.

income.read: This income-focused mode prioritizes steady monthly distributions over growth. It cuts riskier assets and focuses on income ETFs, aiming for low drawdowns. Expect lower overall returns, with distributions being variable and NAV still subject to market declines.
